guide.title: How to write a GPT Image 2.5 prompt
guide.intro: Five structures that recur in the prompts on this page.

items.formula: Subject + action + camera and lens + light + texture
items.t: Portrait prompts name a lens ("50mm"), the shot distance, the light and the skin or material detail, then say what to avoid, such as heavy retouching.

items.formula: Quoted words + where they sit + type style
items.t: Put every word the image must show in quotes, say where each line goes and how it looks, and ask for correct spelling when the text is long.

items.formula: One change + "keep everything else"
items.t: Edit prompts state a single change and close with what must stay untouched: the face, the layout, the lighting.

items.formula: Count + grid size + what each cell holds + background
items.t: Sticker packs, sprite sheets and poster grids say how many cells there are, how they are arranged, and whether the background is transparent or a flat colour.

items.formula: Fields such as title, scene, subject, lighting, composition
items.t: Long prompts are written as JSON or a Markdown outline, and reusable ones leave a placeholder like {subject} or [OBJECT] to fill in.

items.h: State the shape in the prompt.
items.t: Many prompts include a ratio such as 9:16, 3:4 or 1:3 and a resolution like 4K in the text, which keeps the composition in step with the output size.

items.h: Anchor the style to a real medium or era.
items.t: "Showa-era travel poster", "1994 infomercial" and "90s cel animation" give the model a whole look in a few words.

items.h: Turn an emoji into a material.
items.t: Several prompts take one emoji and render it as chrome, silk, fur, paper or an inflatable, which makes a quick set of matching icons.
The UI prompts list a colour mode, layout, type hierarchy and sections instead of saying "a nice website".
Reference prompts say "the second image" or "image 2" so the model knows which picture supplies the subject and which the setting.

items.h: Lock the scale for animation frames.
items.t: Sprite prompts fix the frame count, grid and character size so the frames line up when you cut them apart.

items.question: Are these GPT Image 2.5 prompts free to use?
items.answer: You can copy, edit and run any prompt. The prompts and result images belong to the creators credited on each card, so read the original post before reusing a result image commercially.

items.question: Which language should I write GPT Image 2.5 prompts in?
items.answer: English or Chinese both work. The prompts here are shown in the author's original language and are not translated, so copy them as they are.

items.question: How do I run a GPT Image 2.5 prompt through the API?
items.answer: Send the prompt to the image generation endpoint with model gpt-image-2.5-flare or gpt-image-2.5-sunburst. prompt is required and n must be 1. The docs recommend "async": true and polling GET /v1/tasks/:task_id every 5 to 10 seconds, and completed results are stored for 24 hours.

items.question: What does Use do on a card?
items.answer: It opens the GPT Image 2.5 model page with the prompt filled in. Reference photos are not attached, so upload your own for the cards marked as needing one.

items.question: Which sizes does GPT Image 2.5 support?
items.answer: Resolution is 1k, 2k or 4k, and size takes one of ten aspect ratios: 3:1, 21:9, 16:9, 3:2, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16 and 1:3. Each ratio maps to a fixed pixel size per tier, listed on the API page.

items.question: Can GPT Image 2.5 edit a photo with reference images?
items.answer: Yes. The API takes 0 to 16 reference images and a mask, which is how the editing cards on this page work. The mask limits the change to a region.

items.question: How is GPT Image 2.5 billed?
items.answer: By the tokens each result uses, not per image. Quality can be low, medium, high, xhigh, max or auto, and higher quality uses more output tokens. Current rates are on the model page.

items.question: What is the difference between gpt-image-2.5-flare and gpt-image-2.5-sunburst?
items.answer: The APIKO docs list both with the same parameters, sizes, reference limits and token billing, and do not state any other difference. Either ID runs the prompts on this page.

items.question: Why does my GPT Image 2.5 result look different from the card?
items.answer: Image models are not deterministic, so the same prompt gives different results on each run. The author may also have used other settings or tools, or edited the output afterwards.

items.question: How do I get exact text in a GPT Image 2.5 image?
items.answer: Quote the words, say where each line sits and what the lettering looks like, and keep the text short. The poster and brand cards above show the pattern, so check every result for spelling before you use it.

guide.title: GPT Image 2.5 提示词怎么写
guide.intro: 这些提示词里反复出现的五种结构。

items.formula: 主体 + 动作 + 机位与镜头 + 光线 + 质感
items.t: 人像提示词会写明镜头（如 50mm）、景别、光线和皮肤或材质细节，最后补一句要避免的内容，比如过度修图。

items.formula: 加引号的文字 + 摆放位置 + 字体样式
items.t: 画面里要出现的每个字都放进引号，说清每行放哪、长什么样，文字较长时要求拼写正确。

items.formula: 一处改动 + “其余保持不变”
items.t: 编辑类提示词只说一处改动，结尾列出必须保留的部分：人脸、版式、光线。

items.formula: 数量 + 网格规格 + 每格内容 + 背景
items.t: 贴纸、精灵图和海报阵列会写明格数、排列方式，以及背景是透明还是纯色。

items.formula: 标题、场景、主体、光线、构图等字段
items.t: 长提示词写成 JSON 或 Markdown 大纲，可复用的会留出 {主体}、[OBJECT] 这样的占位符待填。
不少提示词在正文里写明 9:16、3:4、1:3 之类的比例和 4K 分辨率，让构图和输出尺寸对得上。

items.h: 用真实媒介或年代定风格。
items.t: “昭和旅行海报”“1994 年电视购物”“90 年代赛璐璐动画”几个字就能交代整体画风。
有几条提示词拿一个 emoji 渲染成镀铬、丝绸、绒毛、纸艺或充气物，很容易做出一套风格统一的图标。
界面类提示词会列出色彩模式、版式、字体层级和区块，而不是只说“好看的网站”。
参考图提示词会写“第二张图”“图 2”，让模型分清哪张提供主体、哪张提供场景。
精灵图提示词固定帧数、网格和角色大小，方便后期切图时各帧对齐。

items.question: 这些 GPT Image 2.5 提示词可以免费使用吗？
items.answer: 提示词可以随意复制、修改和运行。提示词和效果图归每张卡片标注的创作者所有，想把效果图用于商业用途，请先看原帖。

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 提示词用中文还是英文写？
items.answer: 中文和英文都可以。这里的提示词保持作者的原文，没有翻译，直接复制即可。

items.question: 怎样用 API 运行一条 GPT Image 2.5 提示词？
items.answer: 向图像生成接口发送提示词，model 填 gpt-image-2.5-flare 或 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst。prompt 必填，n 只能为 1。文档建议传 "async": true，每 5 到 10 秒轮询一次 GET /v1/tasks/:task_id，完成的结果保存 24 小时。

items.question: 卡片上的“使用”按钮做什么？
items.answer: 它会打开 GPT Image 2.5 的模型页并填好提示词。参考照片不会一并带上，标注需要参考图的卡片请上传你自己的图。

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 支持哪些尺寸？
items.answer: 分辨率有 1k、2k、4k，size 可选十种比例：3:1、21:9、16:9、3:2、4:3、1:1、3:4、2:3、9:16、1:3。每个比例在每档分辨率下对应固定像素，列在 API 页面。

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 能用参考图改图吗？
items.answer: 可以。API 支持 0 到 16 张参考图和蒙版，本页的图片编辑类卡片就是这么用的，蒙版可以把改动限制在某个区域。

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 怎么计费？
items.answer: 按每个结果实际用到的 token 计费，不按张数。画质可选 low、medium、high、xhigh、max 或 auto，画质越高输出 token 越多。当前费率见模型页。

items.question: gpt-image-2.5-flare 和 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst 有什么区别？
items.answer: APIKO 文档里两者的参数、尺寸、参考图上限和 token 计费完全相同，没有写明其他区别。本页的提示词用哪个 ID 都能跑。

items.question: 为什么我用 GPT Image 2.5 跑出来和卡片上的图不一样？
items.answer: 图像模型不是确定性的，同一条提示词每次跑结果都不同。作者也可能用了别的设置或工具，或在出图后做过修改。

items.question: 怎样让 GPT Image 2.5 把文字写对？
items.answer: 把文字放进引号，说明每行的位置和字体样子，文字尽量短。上面的海报和品牌卡片可以参考，出图后仍要逐字检查拼写。

guide.title: GPT Image 2.5 提示詞怎麼寫
guide.intro: 這些提示詞裡反覆出現的五種結構。

items.formula: 主體 + 動作 + 機位與鏡頭 + 光線 + 質感
items.t: 人像提示詞會寫明鏡頭（如 50mm）、景別、光線與皮膚或材質細節，最後補上要避免的內容，例如過度修圖。

items.formula: 加引號的文字 + 擺放位置 + 字體樣式
items.t: 畫面中要出現的每個字都放進引號，說清楚每行放哪裡、長什麼樣子，文字較長時要求拼寫正確。

items.formula: 一處修改 + 「其餘維持不變」
items.t: 編輯類提示詞只說一處修改，結尾列出必須保留的部分：臉部、版面、光線。

items.formula: 數量 + 網格規格 + 每格內容 + 背景
items.t: 貼圖、精靈圖與海報陣列會寫明格數、排列方式，以及背景是透明還是純色。

items.formula: 標題、場景、主體、光線、構圖等欄位
items.t: 較長的提示詞寫成 JSON 或 Markdown 大綱，可重複使用的會留下 {主體}、[OBJECT] 這類佔位符待填。
不少提示詞在內文寫明 9:16、3:4、1:3 之類的比例與 4K 解析度，讓構圖與輸出尺寸對得上。

items.h: 用真實媒材或年代定風格。
items.t: 「昭和旅行海報」「1994 年電視購物」「90 年代賽璐珞動畫」幾個字就能交代整體畫風。
有幾條提示詞拿一個 emoji 渲染成鍍鉻、絲綢、絨毛、紙藝或充氣物，很容易做出一組風格一致的圖示。
介面類提示詞會列出色彩模式、版面、字體層級與區塊，而不是只說「好看的網站」。
參考圖提示詞會寫「第二張圖」「圖 2」，讓模型分清哪張提供主體、哪張提供場景。
精靈圖提示詞固定幀數、網格與角色大小，之後切圖時各幀才對得齊。

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 提示詞要用中文還是英文寫？
items.answer: 中文與英文都可以。這裡的提示詞保留作者的原文、沒有翻譯，直接複製即可。

items.question: 如何用 API 執行一條 GPT Image 2.5 提示詞？
items.answer: 把提示詞送到圖像生成端點，model 填 gpt-image-2.5-flare 或 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst。prompt 為必填，n 只能是 1。文件建議傳 "async": true，每 5 到 10 秒輪詢一次 GET /v1/tasks/:task_id，完成的結果會保存 24 小時。

items.question: 卡片上的「使用」按鈕會做什麼？
items.answer: 它會開啟 GPT Image 2.5 的模型頁並填入提示詞。參考照片不會一併帶入，標註需要參考圖的卡片請上傳你自己的圖。

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 支援哪些尺寸？
items.answer: 解析度有 1k、2k、4k，size 可選十種比例：3:1、21:9、16:9、3:2、4:3、1:1、3:4、2:3、9:16、1:3。每個比例在每個檔位都對應固定像素，列在 API 頁面。

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 可以用參考圖修圖嗎？
items.answer: 可以。API 支援 0 到 16 張參考圖與遮罩，本頁的圖片編輯卡片就是這樣用的，遮罩可以把修改限制在某個區域。

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 如何計費？
items.answer: 依每個結果實際用到的 token 計費，不是按張數。畫質可選 low、medium、high、xhigh、max 或 auto，畫質越高輸出 token 越多。目前費率請看模型頁。

items.question: gpt-image-2.5-flare 與 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst 有什麼差別？

items.question: 為什麼我用 GPT Image 2.5 跑出來和卡片上的圖不一樣？

items.question: 怎樣讓 GPT Image 2.5 把文字寫對？

guide.title: GPT Image 2.5 프롬프트 작성법
guide.intro: 이 페이지의 프롬프트에서 반복되는 다섯 가지 구조입니다.

items.formula: 피사체 + 동작 + 카메라와 렌즈 + 조명 + 질감
items.t: 인물 프롬프트는 렌즈(예: 50mm), 촬영 거리, 조명, 피부나 소재의 디테일을 적고, 과한 보정처럼 피할 것을 덧붙입니다.

items.formula: 따옴표 안의 문구 + 위치 + 글씨체
items.t: 이미지에 들어갈 모든 글자를 따옴표로 묶고, 줄마다 위치와 모양을 적습니다. 문구가 길면 철자를 정확히 쓰라고 요청합니다.

items.formula: 바꿀 한 가지 + "나머지는 그대로"
items.t: 편집 프롬프트는 바꿀 것을 하나만 말하고, 마지막에 얼굴, 레이아웃, 조명처럼 유지할 것을 적습니다.

items.formula: 개수 + 그리드 크기 + 칸별 내용 + 배경
items.t: 스티커, 스프라이트 시트, 포스터 그리드는 칸 수와 배치, 배경이 투명인지 단색인지를 적습니다.

items.formula: 제목, 장면, 피사체, 조명, 구도 같은 항목
items.t: 긴 프롬프트는 JSON이나 마크다운 개요로 쓰고, 재사용용은 {subject}, [OBJECT] 같은 자리표시자를 남깁니다.
9:16, 3:4, 1:3 같은 비율과 4K 해상도를 본문에 적어 구도를 출력 크기에 맞춘 프롬프트가 많습니다.
"쇼와 시대 여행 포스터", "1994년 홈쇼핑", "90년대 셀 애니메이션"처럼 몇 단어로 전체 화풍이 정해집니다.
이모지 하나를 크롬, 실크, 털, 종이 공예, 풍선 질감으로 렌더링한 프롬프트가 여러 개 있어, 통일감 있는 아이콘 세트를 만들기 쉽습니다.
UI 프롬프트는 "예쁜 웹사이트" 대신 색상 모드, 레이아웃, 글자 위계, 섹션을 나열합니다.
참조 프롬프트는 "두 번째 이미지", "image 2"처럼 써서 어느 사진이 피사체이고 어느 사진이 배경인지 구분합니다.
스프라이트 프롬프트는 프레임 수, 그리드, 캐릭터 크기를 고정해 잘라 낼 때 프레임이 어긋나지 않게 합니다.

items.question: 이 GPT Image 2.5 프롬프트는 무료로 쓸 수 있나요?
items.answer: 프롬프트는 자유롭게 복사, 수정, 실행할 수 있습니다. 프롬프트와 결과 이미지는 각 카드에 표시된 제작자의 것이니, 결과 이미지를 상업적으로 쓰려면 원문 게시물을 먼저 확인하세요.

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 프롬프트는 어떤 언어로 써야 하나요?
items.answer: 영어와 중국어 모두 됩니다. 이 페이지의 프롬프트는 작성자의 원문 그대로이며 번역하지 않았으니 그대로 복사하세요.

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 프롬프트를 API로 실행하려면 어떻게 하나요?
items.answer: 이미지 생성 엔드포인트에 프롬프트를 보내고 model에 gpt-image-2.5-flare 또는 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst를 넣습니다. prompt는 필수이고 n은 1이어야 합니다. 문서는 "async": true를 권장하며, GET /v1/tasks/:task_id를 5~10초마다 조회하고, 완료된 결과는 24시간 보관됩니다.

items.question: 카드의 '사용' 버튼은 무엇을 하나요?
items.answer: GPT Image 2.5 모델 페이지를 열고 프롬프트를 채워 줍니다. 참조 사진은 함께 붙지 않으므로 참조가 필요한 카드는 직접 이미지를 올리세요.

items.question: GPT Image 2.5는 어떤 크기를 지원하나요?
items.answer: 해상도는 1k, 2k, 4k이고 size는 3:1, 21:9, 16:9, 3:2, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16, 1:3 열 가지 비율 중에서 고릅니다. 비율마다 해상도별 고정 픽셀 크기가 있으며 API 페이지에 나와 있습니다.

items.question: GPT Image 2.5로 참조 이미지를 넣어 사진을 편집할 수 있나요?
items.answer: 가능합니다. API는 참조 이미지 0~16장과 마스크를 받으며, 이 페이지의 이미지 편집 카드가 그렇게 쓰입니다. 마스크로 바꿀 영역을 한정할 수 있습니다.

items.question: GPT Image 2.5는 요금이 어떻게 계산되나요?
items.answer: 장수가 아니라 결과마다 실제로 쓴 토큰 기준입니다. 품질은 low, medium, high, xhigh, max, auto 중에서 고르며, 품질이 높을수록 출력 토큰이 늘어납니다. 현재 요금은 모델 페이지에서 확인하세요.

items.question: gpt-image-2.5-flare와 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst는 무엇이 다른가요?
items.answer: APIKO 문서에는 두 모델의 파라미터, 크기, 참조 이미지 한도, 토큰 과금이 같게 적혀 있고 그 밖의 차이는 명시되어 있지 않습니다. 이 페이지의 프롬프트는 어느 ID로든 실행할 수 있습니다.

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 결과가 카드의 이미지와 다른 이유는 무엇인가요?
items.answer: 이미지 모델은 결정적이지 않아 같은 프롬프트도 실행할 때마다 결과가 달라집니다. 작성자가 다른 설정이나 도구를 썼거나 출력 후 수정했을 수도 있습니다.

items.question: GPT Image 2.5 이미지에 문구를 정확히 넣으려면 어떻게 하나요?
items.answer: 문구를 따옴표로 묶고, 줄마다 위치와 글씨 모양을 적고, 글자는 짧게 유지하세요. 위의 포스터와 브랜드 카드가 참고가 되며, 결과의 철자는 항상 직접 확인해야 합니다.

cards.prompt:
Create a premium, ultra-refined Showa-era Japanese vintage travel poster for [LOCATION].

FORMAT: Vertical 3:4 | Collector’s travel poster | Mid-century Japanese railway tourism aesthetic

CORE CONCEPT

Create a beautifully composed, instantly recognizable travel scene representing [LOCATION]. Feature its most iconic landmark, architecture, landscape, streets, transportation, and atmospheric details, selecting elements that naturally define the destination.

Reimagine the scene as an authentic 1960s–1970s Japanese railway tourism poster, inspired by classic Japanese National Railways travel advertising and sophisticated vintage screen-printed graphics.

The result should feel like an originally designed vintage poster, not a modern photograph with a retro filter.

VISUAL STYLE

Use bold geometric forms, simplified architecture, clean perspective lines, strong silhouettes, and elegant flat graphic shapes.

Combine sophisticated mid-century Japanese graphic design with traditional screen-print and lithographic aesthetics. Keep the composition cinematic, balanced, spacious, and visually striking.

People and vehicles should be minimal and stylized rather than photorealistic.

COLOR & PRINT TEXTURE

Use a restrained vintage palette of:
deep navy blue, warm ivory/aged paper, muted mustard yellow, and vermilion red accents.

Use flat printed color fields rather than digital gradients. Add subtle paper grain, authentic ink texture, slight ink wear, and delicate vintage print misregistration for a convincing screen-printed feel.

Avoid neon colors, glossy 3D rendering, excessive photorealism, modern AI-art aesthetics, and overly saturated colors.

TYPOGRAPHY & LAYOUT

Reserve generous negative space at the bottom for elegant vintage typography.

Main title: "[LOCATION]"
Large, bold, geometric sans-serif lettering.

Add a refined, location-appropriate subtitle beneath it with generous letter spacing.

Place 2026 discreetly at the bottom left and No.01 at the bottom right.

Typography should feel authentic to a premium Japanese railway tourism poster: restrained, elegant, highly legible, and perfectly integrated into the artwork.

FINAL RESULT

Create a timeless, sophisticated Japanese Showa-era travel poster that feels like a rare original screen-printed railway advertisement from the 1960s–1970s, while showcasing the unique identity, beauty, and most recognizable visual characteristics of [LOCATION].

IMPORTANT: Make [LOCATION] immediately recognizable. Prioritize iconic local landmarks, authentic architecture, distinctive landscapes, and culturally characteristic details. Do not invent generic scenery that could represent any destination.

cards.preview: Turn the character in my uploaded reference image into an adorable pixel-art sprite with a looping idle animation. CHARACTER Use the uploaded image as the character reference. Preserve the character’s recognizable features, colors, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, and distinctive
cards.prompt:
Turn the character in my uploaded reference image into an adorable pixel-art sprite with a looping idle animation.

CHARACTER
Use the uploaded image as the character reference. Preserve the character’s recognizable features, colors, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, and distinctive silhouette. Adapt its original anatomy into cute chibi proportions without forcing non-human characters into a human body. If the reference is cropped, infer the missing body details to match the visible design.

STYLE
Create crisp pixel art with clearly defined square pixels, clean outlines, and a cohesive limited palette. No blurry edges, smooth vector styling, or realistic rendering.

ANIMATION
Create 16 consecutive frames of one subtle, seamless idle animation:
- Gentle breathing with a tiny rise and fall of the upper body.
- Slight secondary movement in hair, clothing, or relevant appendages.
- One brief natural blink if the character has visible eyes.
- Keep the character in place, with its feet or contact points anchored.
- Keep the design, proportions, camera angle, and scale consistent.
- No walking, turning, dramatic gestures, or scene changes.
- Make the last frame transition smoothly back to the first.

SPRITE SHEET
Arrange the 16 frames in exactly 4 columns × 4 rows, ordered left to right, top to bottom.
Canvas: 1024 × 1024 pixels.
Each cell: 256 × 256 pixels.
Use identical alignment and a fixed baseline across all cells.
Keep the entire character inside each cell, with at least 16 pixels of transparent padding on every side, including around moving accessories.
No overlapping cells, grid lines, labels, text, or watermarks.

TRANSPARENCY
Use a genuinely transparent RGBA background with alpha zero outside the character.
Do not draw a checkerboard or add a solid background, floor, or cast shadow.
Preserve white and pale details inside the character.

DELIVERABLES
Complete the actual files, not just instructions:
1. A transparent 4 × 4 PNG sprite sheet.
2. A transparent animated GIF of the single character, using all 16 frames at 256 × 256 pixels, looping forever with an approximately 2.4-second cycle.
3. A ZIP containing all 16 individual transparent PNG frames.

Use available image-generation and file-processing tools to generate the artwork, split the sheet, and assemble the GIF. Use nearest-neighbor sampling if resizing is needed to preserve crisp pixels.

Before exporting, inspect all 16 frames. Remove stray pixels and any fragments from neighboring cells, especially above the head or below the feet. Check for clipping, unwanted position jumps, background artifacts, and GIF trails. Ensure the final PNG and GIF backgrounds are truly transparent.

cards.prompt:
主题：文化评论 / 英语等级：B2 / 字数：400

生成一份高端黑白社论风格的英文文章排版，类似于高级文学杂志、文化期刊或报纸专题页面。

文章语言必须为英语，写作必须严格遵循第一行指定的 CEFR 英语等级。英语等级可选 A1、A2、B1、B2、C1 或 C2；“主题”为文章话题；“字数”为目标英文单词数。

英语难度要求：
- A1：非常基础，使用高频词汇和简单的短句。
- A2：常用生活词汇，简单的连接词和基础复合句。
- B1：更丰富的日常和抽象词汇，包含原因、示例和观点。
- B2：成熟的论证表达，词汇丰富，句式结构复杂且逻辑层次分明。
- C1：高级、准确且自然的英语，具备文学品质。
- C2：近乎母语者的文化评论或文学社论水平，运用细腻的修辞和抽象概念。

文章必须围绕指定主题展开，字数控制在目标字数的 ±10% 以内。排版应包含顶部的简洁报头（例如“THE LITERARY REVIEW”）、主标题使用优雅的高对比度衬线字体、作者署名以及三栏式社论网格。左侧包含一段醒目的粗体斜体引语，中心配有一张大型黑白纪实照片及说明文字。整体美学应克制、理性且具有学术感，使用带有轻微油墨晕染和颗粒感的米白色新闻纸纹理。仅限使用黑色、深灰色和米白色。底部应设有一个包含大型斜体行动号召（Call to Action）的信息框。

cards.preview: Create a complete cinematic storyboard and styleframe board for a premium fintech / advertising management SaaS product called “AdRevival Private Management”. The final output should be ONE SINGLE LARGE STORYBOARD BOARD, not one individual slide. Use a dark charcoal-gray
cards.prompt:
Create a complete cinematic storyboard and styleframe board for a premium fintech / advertising management SaaS product called “AdRevival Private Management”.

The final output should be ONE SINGLE LARGE STORYBOARD BOARD, not one individual slide.

Use a dark charcoal-gray infinite-canvas background, like a professional Figma or creative-director presentation board. Arrange approximately 20 polished 16:9 video keyframes in a clean horizontal production storyboard, grouped into clearly separated narrative sections.

Add small black rounded section labels above the columns:
“Hook”
“Intro”
“Use case”
“CTA”

Every frame should have a tiny scene label in its upper-left corner such as “Scene 1a”, “Scene 1b”, “Scene 2a”, etc.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
Premium, cinematic, minimal, high-end motion-design style.
Black and near-black backgrounds, deep midnight blue, subtle violet-blue light, champagne gold and warm yellow accents, white typography.
Elegant gradients, soft bloom, subtle grain, faint dot-grid textures, volumetric glow, dramatic vignettes, polished reflections.
Clean Swiss / Apple / fintech editorial typography, similar to Helvetica Neue / Inter / SF Pro.
Large kinetic typography combined with clean SaaS dashboard UI.
Sophisticated but restrained, not flashy.
Consistent visual identity across every frame.
Professional motion graphics agency quality.
No random stock photography.
No clutter.
All frames should look like finished title cards from the same commercial.

STORY / SHOT SEQUENCE:

HOOK
Scene 1a:
Minimal dark blue frame. A small circular AdRevival brand symbol in the center followed by the word “For”. Lots of negative space.

Scene 1b:
Same composition evolving into the phrase “For 2 years”, with “2 years” subtly highlighted in blue-violet.

Scene 1c:
Centered “AdRevival” wordmark and circular symbol on a deep blue-black gradient background.

Scene 1d:
A dramatic monetary milestone frame showing “$500,000,000” in elegant white type, surrounded by curved orbital lines and several glowing social / advertising platform icons, including a TikTok-like icon. Rich deep-blue lighting.

INTRO
Scene 2a:
Huge kinetic word “Now” filling most of the frame. White typography fading into violet. A glowing purple horizon/platform beneath the word.

Scene 2b:
Large word “Distributed” across the upper part of the frame. Beneath it, a cinematic laptop displaying a premium dark dashboard, sitting in a moody purple-blue environment.

Scene 2c:
Centered laptop with the same dashboard. Several circular platform/account icons floating around it, connected visually as a distributed advertising ecosystem.

PRIVATE MANAGEMENT INTRODUCTION
Scene 3a:
Minimal black frame with centered white word “Introducing”. A subtle warm gold glow beneath it.

Scene 3b:
Huge word “Private”, left aligned, partially fading into a dark champagne-gold silhouette / atmospheric background.

Scene 3c:
Centered premium logo lockup:
“AdRevival”
“Private Management”
white logo on a black-to-gold gradient background.

PRODUCT / USE CASE
Scene 4a:
Show a realistic premium dark-mode SaaS advertising management dashboard. Black interface with violet and gold highlights, cards, account data, navigation sidebar and analytical information.

Scene 4b:
Minimal typographic card emphasizing “6% of cashback”, with “6%” in champagne gold and the rest in white. Include a thin gold rounded graphical accent around the percentage.

Scene 4c:
The statement “6% of cashback on all platforms” centered horizontally. Surround it with several floating metallic gold coins / platform symbols in depth.

Scene 5a:
Another close-up of the AdRevival dashboard showing multiple managed advertising accounts or platforms. Dark interface, gold borders and violet CTA elements.

Scene 5b:
Blur the dashboard slightly in the background and place a centered premium confirmation/modal card in front. Add an oversized elegant gold cursor arrow pointing at the primary action button.

Scene 6a:
Minimal title card:
“The highest level”
with “highest level” subtly emphasized in warm gold.

Scene 6b:
A refined graphical interpretation of:
“The highest level of management in every platform”
using two small circular gold platform/account icons above or beside the typography.

SUPPORT
Scene 7a:
A floating dark chat/message bubble outlined in gold saying:
“Can I manage multiple platforms?”
against a luxurious black-to-gold background.

Scene 7b:
Split editorial layout. Large bold typography:
“24/7
Support”
on the left, and a realistic dark chat-support interface screenshot on the right.

Scene 8a:
Minimal typographic transition:
“No More > Insiders
Chat Support”
where “No More” is highlighted in gold and the remaining words are muted white/gray.

Scene 8b:
Create a second variation of this frame with slightly different line breaks and hierarchy, still emphasizing “No More” in gold.

Scene 9a:
Minimal atmospheric frame with the phrase:
“Keys to the castle”
in muted champagne-gold typography on a black background with fine dot-grid texture.

Scene 9b:
Minimal title card:
“Unbeatable Cashback”
with subtle gold gradient typography and dark grid texture.

CTA
Scene 10a:
Final premium brand end card.
Centered AdRevival circular logo and wordmark:
“AdRevival”
“Private Management”
on a black-to-champagne-gold cinematic background.
Small line of copy underneath:
“Only with AdRevival Private Management.”

BOARD LAYOUT:
Present all of these keyframes simultaneously on one large dark creative-direction board.
Frames should be approximately the same size and aligned to an invisible grid.
Use generous spacing between groups.
Hook on the far left, Intro next, Use case occupying the largest center section, CTA on the far right.
Some columns may contain 3–5 vertically stacked frames.
Leave intentional empty space around the storyboard.
Add a few tiny production notes above the central columns, like a real creative director’s working board.
The overall image should look like an exported Figma storyboard / motion-design treatment made by a world-class branding studio.

Extremely polished, coherent art direction, readable typography, consistent logo usage, accurate UI proportions, high fidelity, presentation-ready.

cards.preview: Design a light-mode web interface screen: crisp cobalt workspace balancing enterprise performance metrics with card-based template discovery. LAYOUT Structured fixed-width vertical sidebar navigation (approximately 240px wide) pinned to the left, paired with a dynamic
cards.prompt:
Design a light-mode web interface screen: crisp cobalt workspace balancing enterprise performance metrics with card-based template discovery.

LAYOUT
Structured fixed-width vertical sidebar navigation (approximately 240px wide) pinned to the left, paired with a dynamic fluid-width content canvas. The main pane begins with a global utility bar, descends into an executive header and search toolbar, flows into an analytics summary layer (5 metric cards above a split 2:1 chart and leaderboard section), and concludes with a responsive 3-column template gallery grid.

PALETTE (use these exact hex values)
- #F8F9FC — App Background: Global application page background surrounding sidebar and main content area
- #FFFFFF — Card Surface: Background for dashboard metric tiles, performance charts, and template cards
- #FFFFFF — Sidebar Surface: Vertical navigation container background separating controls from page content
- #1E6BFF — Cobalt Blue: Primary interactive color for action buttons, active navigation states, and primary trend lines
- #EBF2FE — Soft Blue Tint: Background for active pill filters, badge tags, and selected sidebar items
- #42C3EE — Cyan Accent: Secondary comparison line on charts and conversion rate badge accents
- #10B981 — Positive Green: Positive delta indicators, conversion trend percentages, and success status tags
- #0F172A — Text Primary: High-contrast headings, main metric values, and template titles
- #64748B — Text Secondary: Subheadings, axis labels, inactive navigation links, and microcopy descriptions
- #EEF2F6 — Card Border: Delicate containment line enclosing cards, input fields, and tab clusters

TYPOGRAPHY
Typeface Inter (or Plus Jakarta Sans,SF Pro Display,Roboto), weights 400/500/600/700. Sizes 11px caption, 12px body-sm, 14px body, 16px body-lg, 18px subheading, 20px heading, 24px heading-lg, 28px display. Tracking -0.02em at headings, 0 at body. Inter (or modern neo-grotesque alternatives like Plus Jakarta Sans) gives the dashboard an ultra-clean, technical precision without sacrificing readability. Tight tracking on large display metrics communicates data authority, while comfortable line heights on labels prevent eye fatigue in dense multi-metric cards. Free open-source alternatives like Inter from Google Fonts perfectly reproduce this aesthetic.

GEOMETRY & SPACING
Corner radii — cards 14px, links 6px, inputs 10px, buttons 8px. Spacing on a 8px unit, 20px gaps, 32px between sections, 1360px container, comfortable density.

DEPTH
Depth is handled predominantly through soft planar layering: a pale #F8F9FC background hosting pure white (#FFFFFF) panels bordered with crisp 1px strokes (#EEF2F6). True shadows are minimal, reserved for selected segmented tabs (0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)) and occasional subtle card hover states (0 8px 16px rgba(15,23,42,0.04)).

IMAGERY
Thumbnail imagery showcases scaled-down, pristine marketing landing pages with rounded hero sections, clean typography, and vibrant UI illustrations. Previews are enclosed in light containers mimicking actual viewport frames with delicate 1px borders. Never use uncurated, photographic stock art without an enclosing browser or mobile frame.

SIGNATURE DETAIL — the thing that makes this design itself
The dual-button action footer docked directly below a three-column micro-metrics summary inside each template card. This pairing of deep operational statistics with direct 'Preview' and 'Use Template' CTAs transforms standard gallery cards into actionable performance assets. Misusing it involves separating the metrics from the thumbnail or hiding the primary CTA inside a dropdown menu.

MUST
- Use solid white (#FFFFFF) for every data card against the cool #F8F9FC canvas background.
- Limit intense blue (#1E6BFF) to primary interactive buttons, active indicators, and hero line paths.
- Enclose thumbnail website screenshots in rounded 8px interior frames within template cards.
- Pair numeric labels with compact secondary metadata arranged in structured 3-column micro grids.

AVOID
- Do not use dark gray or black backgrounds for metric cards or chart panels.
- Do not drop thumbnail borders or shadows entirely, causing them to blend into the white card.
- Avoid colored backgrounds for the main canvas that stray outside cool, pale blue-tinted grays.
- Never use sharp 0px corners on input fields, buttons, or card surfaces.

OUTPUT
Render as a clean, pixel-crisp UI design at roughly 1280:3840. Flat vector rendering, real legible text, no browser chrome, no device mockup frame, no watermark, no lorem ipsum placeholder blocks.

cards.prompt:
Design a light-mode mobile app interface screen: pillowy cloudscapes and organic pastel surfaces guiding calm personal storage.

LAYOUT
The mobile layout follows a top-down single-column hierarchy starting with a sticky-feel status and navigation header. Immediately beneath sits a horizontal swipeable hero card carousel showing peeking sibling cards. A two-column split row hosts quick action and search shortcuts, followed by vertical grouped collection cards separated by bold section titles.

PALETTE (use these exact hex values)
- #FFFFFF — Canvas White: Primary mobile viewport background and base level
- #F8FAFB — Surface Mist: Subtle fill for embedded search inputs and inactive surfaces
- #EEF2F3 — Border Subtle: Hairline card outlines, row dividers, and input strokes
- #0D4744 — Deep Teal: Hero display text, prominent pill CTA button, and high-emphasis labels
- #219D82 — Mint Accent: App logo highlight, active tags, and 'PRO' badge fill
- linear-gradient(135deg, #F0FAF7 0%, #E2F5EE 50%, #D8F0F3 100%) — Card Hero Gradient: Background wash for the primary welcome carousel card
- #1E2A2A — Text Charcoal: Row item headings, section titles, and primary action text
- #768B8A — Text Slate: Subtitles, placeholder text, chevron arrows, and metadata
- #EDF8F5 — Badge Mint Tint: Soft pill container fill behind counter numbers

TYPOGRAPHY
Typeface Plus Jakarta Sans (or Outfit, SF Pro Rounded, Inter), weights 400/500/600/700. Sizes 10px caption, 11px body-sm, 13px body, 14px body-lg, 15px subheading, 17px heading, 24px display. Tracking -0.01em at headlines, 0.08em at uppercase captions. The typographic tone is airy, friendly, and structured, best embodied by rounded geometric sans typefaces like Plus Jakarta Sans or SF Pro Rounded. Generous lowercase proportions paired with letterspaced micro-caps ('WELCOME TO') keep utility feeling relaxed and modern. System fonts like SF Pro with rounded attributes provide seamless zero-cost implementation.

GEOMETRY & SPACING
Corner radii — cards 24px, links 8px, inputs 18px, buttons 999px. Spacing on a 4px unit, 12px gaps, 24px between sections, 390px container, comfortable density.

DEPTH
Depth is created without harsh drop shadows. Instead, surfaces rely on 1px crisp borders (#EEF2F3) set against stark white (#FFFFFF) and delicate background pastel gradients. A very soft, diffuse ambient blur (0px 8px 24px rgba(13, 71, 68, 0.04)) is permitted strictly under active floating cards.

IMAGERY
Visual assets consist of simplified 3D-shaded cloud volumes and stylized vector pictograms. Cloud assets use clean semi-translucent overlapping curvilinear lobes in seafoam green and white. Photorealistic photography is restricted entirely to circular user profile avatars.

SIGNATURE DETAIL — the thing that makes this design itself
The mint-washed cloudscape hero card featuring an overlapping curved vector cloud silhouette paired with a deep teal pill button. This establishes the calm 'cloud sanctuary' motif immediately on launch. Misusing it means replacing the organic vector curves with generic stock photography or harsh linear gradients.

MUST
- Wrap related collection rows inside a single bordered card with 20px corner radius.
- Use pill-shaped 999px radii exclusively for action buttons, pro tags, and count badges.
- Maintain high contrast on headings by pairing Deep Teal (#0D4744) with pure white backgrounds.
- Enclose row icons inside squircle containers tinted to match the icon's primary hue.

AVOID
- Never apply harsh black (#000000) for typography; use #0D4744 or #1E2A2A instead.
- Never use sharp 90-degree corners on buttons, cards, or search inputs.
- Avoid heavy drop shadows; depth is conveyed via faint 1px borders and soft pastel fills.
- Do not make count badges bright red or amber; use the soothing mint pill #EDF8F5.

OUTPUT
Render as a clean, pixel-crisp UI design at roughly 2000:3840. Flat vector rendering, real legible text, no browser chrome, no device mockup frame, no watermark, no lorem ipsum placeholder blocks.

cards.prompt:
Design a dark-mode website section: luminescent deep-space fin-tech precision balancing editorial typography against kinetic particle intelligence.

LAYOUT
The page follows an asymmetric split with 55% dedicated to typographic storytelling on the left and 45% to particle visual telemetry on the right. Vertical flow begins with a floating global nav bar, drops to a live status indicator, followed by the compact 4-line display headline. Two inline CTA buttons anchor the midsection, resolving into three horizontal micro-feature pillars along the lower third.

PALETTE (use these exact hex values)
- #03080A — Obsidian Deep Void: Foundational canvas background absorbing light to give prominence to bioluminescent particle effects
- #081B1E — Teal Frost Tint: Semi-transparent backdrop for HUD cards and floating telemetry nodes
- #4EE29B — Bioluminescent Mint: Primary action button fill, headline italic emphasis, and active data glow points
- #E07A38 — Solar Copper: Status indicator dot, secondary filament stream, and contrasting data points
- #F3F7F6 — Primary Milk White: Display headlines, primary numbers in floating cards, and brand wordmark
- #7E999B — Muted Cyan Slate: Body copy, navigation links, metadata badges, and feature descriptions

TYPOGRAPHY
Typeface Newsreader Display (or Instrument Serif, GT Super, Playfair Display), weights 400. Sizes 11px caption, 12px body-sm, 14px body, 16px body-lg, 20px subheading, 68px display. Tracking -0.03em. The typographic identity bridges classical heritage finance with hyper-modern computational power. The display serif feels authoritative and established, while the sudden pivot to mint italic introduces dynamism and agility. The supporting sans-serif delivers pristine technical legibility, functioning like cockpit instrumentation alongside an editorial centerpiece.

GEOMETRY & SPACING
Corner radii — cards 10px, links 4px, inputs 8px, buttons 10px. Spacing on a 4px unit, 24px gaps, 96px between sections, 1360px container, comfortable density.

DEPTH
Depth is created purely through luminous optical layering rather than drop shadows. Translucent UI cards sit on level 1 with backdrop-filter blur and 1px luminescent rims, floating physically above the kinetic filament vortex. The base canvas sits in deep spatial regression, illuminated only where particles cast soft radial ambient glows.

IMAGERY
The visual anchor is a high-resolution procedural particle vortex swirling inward like an informational event horizon. The filaments transition dynamically from warm copper sparks to high-density mint cyan threads, symbolizing organized financial intelligence. Flat vector illustrations, stock photography, or standard 2D SaaS charts would completely violate this aesthetic.

SIGNATURE DETAIL — the thing that makes this design itself
The defining hallmark is the bioluminescent semantic headline paired with anchored HUD data pins. Specifically, rendering the core value proposition in italicized radiant mint (#4EE29B) within a classical serif stack, mirrored visually by floating translucent metric cards pinned to a particle nebula. Misusing this by turning the whole headline green or detaching the metric pins turns a bespoke system into a generic dark SaaS template.

MUST
- Use Newsreader italic strictly for highlighting transformative technical phrases in mint (#4EE29B).
- Keep telemetry HUD cards translucent with backdrop-filter blur to blend with particle graphics.
- Maintain 1px hairline connectors with glowing terminal nodes when linking metrics to artwork.
- Pair the dominant bioluminescent mint with subtle copper-orange sparks for natural temperature contrast.

AVOID
- Do not use opaque solid grey or white card backgrounds for the floating HUD metrics.
- Never render the entire headline in italic or in green; isolate only the key descriptor.
- Do not introduce sharp 0px corners; maintain a uniform 8px to 10px rounding on interactive elements.
- Avoid standard high-saturation blues or purples which clash with the bespoke teal-copper palette.

OUTPUT
Render as a clean, pixel-crisp UI design at roughly 1440:896. Flat vector rendering, real legible text, no browser chrome, no device mockup frame, no watermark, no lorem ipsum placeholder blocks.

cards.prompt:
Design a dark-mode website section: deep cosmos clinical precision meets ambient bioluminescent particle waves in a monolithic glass console.

LAYOUT
The viewport is organized into spacious horizontal bands within a disciplined 1240px container. In the hero, a split 55/45 grid pairs an asymmetrical left-aligned message block with a floating clinical data terminal on the right. Below, a massive branded typographic marquee acts as a transitional threshold, plunging seamlessly into a grounded, comprehensive six-column footer container.

PALETTE (use these exact hex values)
- #040711 — Void Deep: Global canvas background, providing total contrast for glowing particle streams and card structures.
- #0a0f1d — Card Trench: Background fill for elevated glassmorphic data widgets and the master footer container.
- #4F46E5 — Electric Indigo: Base tone for primary CTA buttons and the gradient illuminated footer watermark.
- #3B82F6 — Bioluminescent Blue: Bright gradient highlight on call-to-action buttons, active badges, and particle sparks.
- #A78BFA — Soft Lilac: Gradient tail seen in headline glows, wordmark transitions, and ambient backlights.
- #F8FAFC — Pure Clinical: Main headings, high-priority data metrics, and high-emphasis interface elements.
- #8B9BB4 — Starlight Muted: Sub-headings, table descriptors, navigation links, and standard body descriptions.
- #1E293B — Hairline Frost: Subtle borders framing glass cards, input fields, social chips, and table divider lines.

TYPOGRAPHY
Typeface Plus Jakarta Sans (or Inter, SF Pro Display, Manrope), weights 400/500/600/700/800. Sizes 12px caption, 13px body-sm, 14px body, 16px body-lg, 20px subheading, 32px heading, 54px heading-lg, 110px display. Tracking -0.03em at display, -0.01em at body, 0.02em at captions. The typographic tone is authoritative, hyper-modern, and mathematically exact. Plus Jakarta Sans provides crisp geometric terminals and open counters that preserve clinical legibility even at 12px data points. Its tight letter spacing at large weights lends an institutional, deep-tech posture suited for enterprise AI infrastructure.

GEOMETRY & SPACING
Corner radii — cards 20px, links 4px, inputs 8px, buttons 10px. Spacing on a 8px unit, 24px gaps, 96px between sections, 1280px container, comfortable density.

DEPTH
Depth is created through optical transparency and atmospheric lighting rather than realistic physical drop shadows. Dark glass cards (rgba(10,15,29,0.85)) float directly above an organic field of glowing particle vectors and oversized display typography. Strong outer glows (0 8px 24px) are reserved strictly for high-tier CTAs to make them appear self-illuminated against the dark plane.

IMAGERY
Imagery consists exclusively of generative point-cloud particle fields forming undulating ribbons of light in cyan, royal blue, and magenta. The aesthetic evokes flow cytometry, neural networks, or computational fluid dynamics in deep space. Stock photos of doctors, physical hardware, or clinical clip-art are strictly off-brand.

SIGNATURE DETAIL — the thing that makes this design itself
The submerged oversized wordmark layered directly behind the top perimeter of the footer card. This architectural collision between a 110px gradient display title and a frosted, interactive console creates immediate visual permanence that anchors the bottom of the experience. It is misused if made fully opaque or pulled forward into the card's active layer.

MUST
- Use deep midnight blue (#040711) rather than pure neutral black (#000000) for all base backdrops.
- Enclose dense data groupings within frosted cards with 1px border (#1E293B) and 20px corner radii.
- Layer oversized brand typography behind foreground containers to inject deep atmospheric perspective.
- Style primary buttons with radiant multi-stop gradients (#3B82F6 to #4F46E5) and matching colored outer glows.

AVOID
- Do not use high-opacity opaque gray borders; keep card outlines down to translucent hairlines (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)).
- Never replace particle cloud imagery with flat geometric vector shapes or generic stock photography.
- Avoid fully rounded pill buttons for inputs; reserve pills strictly for primary CTAs and status chips.
- Do not make the submerged brand display pure solid white; keep it tinted with the indigo gradient.

OUTPUT
Render as a clean, pixel-crisp UI design at roughly 1792:1024. Flat vector rendering, real legible text, no browser chrome, no device mockup frame, no watermark, no lorem ipsum placeholder blocks.

- #5850ec — Core Indigo: Primary brand accent used on glowing central logos, connector dots, and highlight text

This design contains zero photographic imagery, relying entirely on product abstraction and clean functional vectors. The dashboard preview acts as the hero image, rendered with crisp geometric data visualizations (spline curves, segmented donut charts, and mini status tables). Feature items use flat 40px tinted circular badges housing dual-tone line icons.

SIGNATURE DETAIL — the thing that makes this design itself
The standout signature is the warm rust terracotta primary tone (#C85237) applied to an otherwise razor-sharp, cool-neutral financial SaaS interface. Most SaaS platforms default to blue or emerald; here, rust provides warm editorial humanism without compromising analytic precision. Misusing it means splashing terracotta across large graphic backgrounds rather than reserving it for laser-focused action nodes.

AVOID
- Never use generic royal blue as the primary brand button; the identity relies completely on rust terracotta.
- Do not use dark, heavy drop shadows; keep elevation soft with under 8% black opacity.
- Avoid fully rounded 9999px pills for standard interactive CTA buttons; use 10px rounded rectangles instead.
- Never clutter the left hero text container with more than one primary CTA button.

cards.prompt:
Design a light-mode mobile app interface screen: an editorial gourmet market balancing warm bone surfaces with deep wine accents and pristine studio photography.

LAYOUT
The mobile screen flows vertically: a 54px header with centered serif Discover title flanked by circular menu and search icon buttons; followed by a horizontally scrollable row of 48px pill category chips. Below sits a balanced 2-column grid separated by 16px gutters, each card presenting a generous 1:1.3 aspect ratio showcase.

PALETTE (use these exact hex values)
- #FBF9F7 — Bone Alabaster: Global application canvas background conveying an organic, high-end paper texture feel.
- #FFFFFF — Pure White: Background for product cards, navigation circle buttons, and inactive category pills.
- #85273C — Vintage Bordeaux: Selected category pill state, discount ribbon badges, and heart action stroke.
- #1D1D1F — Charcoal Black: Primary heading typography, product titles, and active numeric price labels.
- #76767A — Muted Slate: Subtitle under Discover header and strikethrough original pricing.
- #EBE8E4 — Neutral Border: Outlines around inactive category pills and circular top bar utility buttons.
- #F5F3F0 — Soft Tint: Fill color for secondary square add-to-cart stepper buttons on cards.

TYPOGRAPHY
Typeface Canela (or Playfair Display, Roslindale, Freight Text), weights 400/500/600. Sizes 11px caption, 13px body-sm, 14px body, 15px subheading, 16px heading, 18px heading-lg, 26px display. Tracking -0.015em. The voice is that of an upscale European providore or boutique sommelier. The serif title ('Discover', product names) introduces refined heritage and artisanal craft, while the neutral modern sans for numbers and labels keeps checkout and discovery pragmatic and fast. Substitutes should prioritize high contrast strokes like Roslindale or Playfair.

GEOMETRY & SPACING
Corner radii — cards 24px, links 999px, inputs 24px, buttons 12px. Spacing on a 4px unit, 16px gaps, 24px between sections, 390px container, airy density.

DEPTH
Depth is handled with exceptional softness. Most elements sit directly on the warm #FBF9F7 ground; product cards use a barely perceptible elevation (box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)) to remain clean and tactile rather than heavily lifted.

IMAGERY
Packaged items and wine bottles are captured as hyper-clean studio packshots floating against transparent or imperceptible white backgrounds. Lighting is soft, high-key diffused with faint physical contact shadows at the base of bottles and trays; lifestyle or cluttered photo backgrounds are entirely excluded.

SIGNATURE DETAIL — the thing that makes this design itself
The distinctive top-right wine-colored (#85273C) discount tab that seamlessly conforms to the card's 24px rounded corner, paired with delicate wine-colored heart lineart and editorial serif titles.

MUST
- Use warm bone white (#FBF9F7) rather than harsh blue-tinted cool grays for canvas backgrounds.
- Pair high-contrast editorial serif headings with crisp geometric sans price labels.
- Keep product photography cleanly masked or studio-isolated with natural soft ground contact shadows.
- Use 24px border radius consistently on all product tile cards.

AVOID
- Do not introduce harsh drop shadows; keep elevation soft with blur radii >= 12px and opacity <= 4%.
- Never use generic fluorescent sale badges; always conform to the dark wine rectangular corner tab.
- Do not use full-width heavy colored banners that disrupt the editorial light aesthetic.
- Avoid using serif typography for small UI metadata like percentages and prices.

OUTPUT
Render as a clean, pixel-crisp UI design at roughly 1280:3840. Flat vector rendering, real legible text, no browser chrome, no device mockup frame, no watermark, no lorem ipsum placeholder blocks.

The five women wear pale silk robes in the ancient Chinese style, soft ivory and blush tones with delicate embroidered hems, their hair swept into simple upswept styles set with delicate hairpins that catch small glints of light. They sit and lean around a low wooden tea table resting on a woven bamboo mat, white porcelain teaware and small pastries arranged between them. One woman pours tea in a steady unhurried pour, the pale liquid catching light as it falls. Beside her, a second woman offers a pastry across the table toward her neighbor, who reaches out with an open hand to accept it, her fingers just meeting the plate's edge. A fourth woman leans in slightly, lips parted mid-conversation, her gaze soft and warm toward the group. The fifth rests her shoulder against the curve of a petal wall, a teacup held loosely in both hands, her eyes lowered in quiet listening. All five wear relaxed, natural poses, their gazes drifting between each other in unforced, overlapping moments of attention.

The peony's interior surrounds them in soft translucent walls — fine branching veins visible through the petal flesh, the edges glowing faintly where afternoon light passes through, the curling petal lips forming a natural open ceiling above the group. Beyond one open gap in the petal wall, the towering stems and stalks of the wider garden rise into view, distant blossoms softening into pale mist and atmospheric haze at the edge of visibility, the miniature world reading as vast and self-contained.

A gentle breeze moves through the floral hall, lifting the edge of a silk scarf, stirring the fine hairs at a hairline, curling the thin ribbon of steam rising from the teapot's spout, and trembling faintly along the petal edges without disturbing the stillness of the seated group. Soft afternoon light filters down through the petal canopy, warm pink bounce light gathering across the near sides of the women's faces and the pale wood of the table, cool lavender shadow settling into the folds of fabric and the deeper recesses between petals where the light doesn't reach.

Captured with a wide-latitude cinema look and a vintage 2x anamorphic character at a wide aperture — gentle oval bokeh on the distant garden stems, soft frame-edge falloff, a light diffusion bloom lifting the brightest petal edges into a soft halation, color-negative daylight film rendition with fine 35mm grain, in an M1 cinematic narrative register. cards.prompt:
"SCENE AND COMPOSITION
A giant Japanese dragon confronting a lone samurai in a vast windswept grassland. Wide view, fixed low camera, both subjects clearly situated in the same landscape. The dragon dominates the left side; the full-body samurai stands on the right, facing left toward the dragon. Leave a clear gap between them. A low, gently rolling horizon divides the open sky from the dense grassy field.

DRAGON
An unmistakably reptilian Japanese serpentine dragon with a long coiled body and an elegant S-curving neck. Large overlapping scale plates, broad segmented belly scutes, hard triangular dorsal spines, swept-back antler-like horns and a few long, smooth whiskers. An elongated reptilian skull with visible nostrils, an armored brow and a slightly open jaw showing sharp conical teeth. Powerful clawed forelimbs planted in the grass. Its head angles downward toward the samurai.

Completely hairless: no fur, mane, beard, feathers, wolf ears or mammalian muzzle. No wings. Define the body with individual scale plates, never hair-like strokes.

SAMURAI
A full-body warrior seen from a three-quarter back/profile angle. Traditional kabuto helmet with a crescent crest, menpo mask, layered shoulder guards, intricately laced lamellar armor, divided armored skirt and shin guards. Knees slightly bent, feet firmly planted, torso leaning into a defensive stance. Both hands hold one katana diagonally upward-left between him and the dragon. Long cloth ties stream sideways in the wind.

FIELD
Dense tall grass fills the foreground and stretches far into the distance. Large bent blades and seed heads near the camera, progressively finer grass toward the horizon. Broad curved bands of leaning grass suggest wind rippling across the entire field. Rich, irregular white scratches describe individual stems against deep black masses.

PALETTE AND RENDERING
A strictly limited palette of cool dark cherry red, approximately #901C35, absolute black and near-white. Flat cherry-red sky; the same red appears between grass blades and in the samurai’s cloth ties.

Realistic dimensional forms translated into an aggressively thresholded black-and-white xerox print. Crushed black shadows, fractured white highlights, dense stippled dithering, scratched engraving, irregular ink coverage and crunchy, slightly pixelated edges. A gritty photocopied dark-fantasy image, not polished digital painting. Preserve fine detail in scales, armor and grass.

No smooth gradients, glossy CGI, clean anime shading, soft lighting, orange-red sky, buildings, trees, mountains, sun, moon, extra characters, duplicate swords, text, logos, borders, panels or watermarks. One complete full-bleed image."

一个 ZIP 文件，包含所有 16 个单独的透明 PNG 帧。
